title: nbn FTTP or HFC 750/50 $60/Month for 6 Months, nbn 25/10 $30/Month for 6 Months (New Customers) @ amaysim
body:
Deal: nbn FTTP or HFC 750/50 $60/Month for 6 Months, nbn 25/10 $30/Month for 6 Months (New Customers) @ amaysim

[hopper] Tempting to downgrade to 25/10. Anyone in this plan share a review
[Anthony8888] I am using 25/10 at the moment, 3 kids can play their iPad and I can work from home. Just basic one it is ok.
[sicaboy] I’m using an old android to tether Felix which has a 40mbps down and around 5mbps up
[Grange Hermit] Bugger, was going to pull the trigger on this, but no IPv6 or static IPv4. Optus.
Will stick with my Spintel 500 / 50 with its 'sticky' IPv4, and IPv6 for $58 for a few months more.
[CR-7] I had a terrible experience with Amaysim. Their connection keeps cutting down. Now I switched to Origin and way much better.
[Dyl] I had the worse with origin, their network was so congested. Samsung live TV wouldn’t even load channels.
Amaysim isn’t great but ended up back with them, origin was THAT bad
[Dyl] These deals are transferable between offers on the app I found, the discount carries across to the upgraded or downgraded plan
[ChickenA] Their 100 upload plan is $15 more than Carbon Comm even with sign up discount, which is what I'm using
